pnpm.//: sharp ships one prebuilt binary per platform via optionalDependencies. Without this, pnpm only installs the platform-specific binary the *lockfile-generating* machine needs — so a lockfile generated on macOS installs sharp-darwin-arm64 and nothing else, and Vercel's linux-x64 build then boots with sharp having no binary it can load. Forcing pnpm to always fetch both binaries makes the same lockfile work on both.
